biography: Leo Martin's journey began not on the paved tracks of international circuits, but amidst the dusty backroads of Guadalajara, Mexico. His father, a mechanic with a passion for classic cars, instilled in him a love for speed and precision. At the age of 10, Leo began tearing around on a makeshift go-kart cobbled together from spare parts, honing his reflexes and fearlessness on the challenging terrain. His breakthrough came at 14, when he entered a local karting competition and, against all odds, secured a stunning victory, catching the attention of a small, independent racing team. Currently, he's fighting tooth and nail to prove himself in the lower formula series, scraping together sponsorships and relying on raw talent to climb the ranks. He represents a new wave of young, ambitious drivers, hungry to make their mark on the motorsport world.
drivingStyle: Leo's driving style is characterized by aggressive overtaking maneuvers and a willingness to push the limits. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into corners with a daring disregard for tire conservation. While his raw speed is undeniable, his aggressive style sometimes leads to costly errors and penalties. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, but struggles with races that require a more conservative and calculated approach.

rivalries.reason: A constant battle for position in the junior series, with several on-track collisions and heated exchanges in the paddock.
Tanaka represents the established order, backed by a major manufacturer, while Martin is the underdog, fueling a rivalry based on class and opportunity.
Both drivers are known for aggressive driving, resulting in multiple incidents where they took each other out of contention.

quirks: Always wears a specific pair of lucky racing socks, even if they're full of holes.

famousQuote: "You either send it, or you go home. There's no in-between."
careerHighlight: Winning the Guadalajara Karting Championship at the age of 14 against vastly more experienced competitors, launching his career.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of a crucial qualifying session due to overzealous driving, costing him a chance at a podium finish and significant championship points.
